# NailIQ

NailIQ is a salon booking and operations platform for nail salons, built in Vancouver, BC, Canada.

## What NailIQ does

- **Online booking**: salons get a shareable nailiq.ca/your-salon booking page; clients book by selecting service, staff, and time slot
- **Walk-in queue**: real-time queue display for walk-in clients — front-desk staff add walk-ins instantly
- **Receptionist center**: live dashboard showing all appointments and walk-ins, staff availability, and queue status
- **Vietnamese-first**: booking flow and dashboard available in Vietnamese and English
- **Staff & service management**: owners manage staff profiles, services, and pricing from the dashboard
- **SMS OTP auth**: phone-number based sign-in with one-time codes via Twilio

## Who uses NailIQ

- Nail salon owners (primarily Vietnamese-Canadian and Vietnamese-American communities)
- Front-desk staff managing bookings and walk-ins

## Pricing

- Free tier: 1 staff, up to 50 bookings/month
- Pro: $39 CAD/month — unlimited bookings and staff, receptionist center, AI upsell, auto review requests
- Studio: $89 CAD/month — multiple locations, priority support
- Enterprise: custom pricing

## Tech

Next.js, React, Supabase (Postgres + Auth + Realtime), Vercel, Twilio. Deployed at nailiq.ca.
